onboarding.description: Use the join page to create a free profile.
Add a display name and the topics you want to hear about.

onboarding.step: Wait for the first real updates
onboarding.description: The member room is new and will fill in after Sami starts streaming.

planned.title: First-stream notices
planned.body: Members can use the site as a stable place to check whether the first stream has started or been announced.

planned.title: Topic preferences
planned.body: The profile can help shape future notes around games, news, movies, tech, politics, and internet culture.

planned.title: Future member notes
planned.body: After real streams exist, Sami can add short notes and updates here without pretending there is an archive today.

guidelines: Do not spam, harass, impersonate, or post private information.
If something has not happened yet, the site should say so.
